main_text.head: SECT XI.
Exercitatio lectionis Arabicæ, ex Cap. sive Surata 58 Alchorani.
main_text.l: fi ma jaalamo llaha ana tara Alam
ألم تر أن الله يعلم ما في
in quod novit De quod attenditis Annon
enim non ? terra in quod & cælis

page.notes: The Arabic lines are copied in reading order from the scan, not letter by letter. Diacritics are approximate, and the Arabic letters of the first line are uncertain. The transliteration word "lardi" has an accent over the l in print, marked [?]. The "?" after "non" is printed. The gloss "conventu" and "sunt" are as printed. The catchword "Intro" is the start of the next page's first word; the printed mark after it is a dash.
